## Mutational signatures

```{r signatures-setup}
# SECTION_DATA[["signatures"]] from R/sections/signatures.R (SigProfilerAssignment, COSMIC)
sig = SECTION_DATA[["signatures"]]
sig_has = !is.null(sig) && length(sig$contexts) > 0
```

```{r signatures-notice}
if (!sig_has) section_notice("SigProfilerAssignment was not run for this sample.")
```

```{r signatures-intro, eval=sig_has, results='asis'}
cat(paste0(
  '<p class="sig-intro">A mutational signature is a characteristic pattern of mutations left ',
  'by a particular process, such as ageing, a DNA-repair defect or an exposure. The ',
  'signatures below are the COSMIC reference signatures that best reconstruct this sample\'s ',
  'mutations; the <em>cosine similarity</em> says how well they do (1 = perfect).</p>\n\n'))
```

```{r signatures-tabs, eval=sig_has, results='asis'}
sig_fmt_int = function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
sig_names = c(SBS = "Single-base substitutions (SBS)", DBS = "Doublet-base substitutions (DBS)",
              ID = "Small insertions and deletions (ID)")
sig_tab_labels = c(SBS = "SBS", DBS = "DBS", ID = "ID")

# Raw HTML through a fenced block, so Pandoc leaves the markup alone
sig_html = function(x) cat("\n```{=html}\n", as.character(x), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")

sig_flag_badges = function(flags) {
  lapply(flags, function(f)
    tags$span(class = paste0("sig-badge sig-badge--", gsub("_", "-", f)), SIG_FLAG_LABELS[[f]]))
}

sig_fit_line = function(k, cx) {
  st = cx$stats
  parts = list(
    tags$span(class = "sig-fit__item",
              tags$strong(sig_fmt_int(st$total)), " mutations"),
    tags$span(class = "sig-fit__item",
              "cosine similarity ",
              tags$strong(if (is.na(st$cosine)) "not available" else sprintf("%.3f", st$cosine)))
  )
  if (length(cx$flags) == 0) {
    parts = c(parts, list(tags$span(class = "sig-badge sig-badge--ok", "Reliable fit")))
  } else {
    parts = c(parts, sig_flag_badges(cx$flags))
  }
  out = list(tags$div(class = "sig-fit", parts))
  if (length(cx$flags) > 0) {
    why = c(few_mutations = sprintf("fewer than %s %s mutations", sig_fmt_int(SIG_MIN_MUTATIONS[[k]]), k),
            poor_fit = sprintf("cosine similarity below %.2f", SIG_MIN_COSINE))[cx$flags]
    out = c(out, list(tags$div(class = "sig-caution",
      tags$strong("Interpret with caution: "),
      paste0(paste(why, collapse = " and "),
             ". These signatures are left out of the overview."))))
  }
  out
}

sig_table = function(act) {
  if (is.null(act) || nrow(act) == 0)
    return(section_notice("No signature assigned: SigProfilerAssignment attributed none of these mutations to a COSMIC signature."))
  rows = lapply(seq_len(nrow(act)), function(i) {
    r = act[i]
    aet = if (!r$in_lookup) tags$span(class = "sig-unknown", "not in lookup") else r$aetiology
    tags$tr(class = if (isTRUE(r$artefact)) "sig-row--artefact" else NULL,
      tags$td(class = "sig-name", r$signature,
              if (isTRUE(r$artefact)) tags$span(class = "sig-badge sig-badge--artefact",
                                                title = "COSMIC lists this as a possible sequencing artefact",
                                                "artefact")),
      tags$td(aet, if (nzchar(r$note)) tags$div(class = "sig-note", r$note)),
      tags$td(class = "sig-num", sig_fmt_int(round(r$mutations))),
      tags$td(class = "sig-num",
              tags$span(class = "sig-pct",
                        tags$span(class = "sig-pct__bar", style = sprintf("width:%.1f%%", r$pct)),
                        tags$span(class = "sig-pct__val", sprintf("%.1f%%", r$pct)))))
  })
  # Opt out of Quarto's table post-processing, which adds Bootstrap's .table and 25% colgroups
  tags$table(class = "sig-table", `data-quarto-disable-processing` = "true",
    tags$thead(tags$tr(tags$th("Signature"), tags$th("Proposed aetiology"),
                       tags$th(class = "sig-num", "Mutations"), tags$th(class = "sig-num", "Share"))),
    tags$tbody(rows))
}

sig_plot = function(k, cx) {
  if (is.null(cx$matrix)) return(section_notice("Mutation matrix not found; no profile to plot."))
  cap = switch(k,
    SBS = "Observed SBS96 profile: substitution class, with the trinucleotide context (5′, reference, 3′ base) below each bar",
    DBS = "Observed DBS78 profile: reference dinucleotide class, with the substituted dinucleotide below each bar",
    ID  = "Observed ID83 profile: Del/Ins of 1 bp (C or T), of repeat units (2–5+ bp) and microhomology-mediated deletions (MH); below each bar the repeat or microhomology length")
  tags$figure(class = "report-figure sig-figure",
    embed_svg_plot(plot_sig_profile(cx$matrix, k), width = 10, height = 2.9,
                   alt = paste(k, "mutational profile"), class = "sig-figure__img"),
    tags$figcaption(class = "report-figure__caption", cap))
}

absent = setdiff(names(SIG_CONTEXTS), names(sig$contexts))

cat("::: {.panel-tabset}\n\n")
for (k in intersect(names(SIG_CONTEXTS), names(sig$contexts))) {
  cx = sig$contexts[[k]]
  cat("### ", sig_tab_labels[[k]],
      if (length(cx$flags) > 0) " · caution" else "", "\n\n", sep = "")
  sig_html(tagList(
    tags$p(class = "sig-context-name", sig_names[[k]]),
    sig_fit_line(k, cx),
    sig_table(cx$activities),
    sig_plot(k, cx)
  ))
}
cat(":::\n\n")

if (length(absent) > 0) {
  sig_html(section_notice(sprintf(
    "No %s fit found. SigProfilerAssignment skips a context in which the sample has no mutations.",
    paste(absent, collapse = " or "))))
}
```

```{r signatures-details, eval=sig_has}
sig_paths = unlist(lapply(names(sig$contexts), function(k) {
  f = sig$contexts[[k]]$files
  c(f$activities, f$stats, f$matrix)
}), use.names = FALSE)
no_stats = names(sig$contexts)[vapply(sig$contexts, function(cx) is.null(cx$files$stats), logical(1))]

table_details(
  summary = "Method and sources",
  tags$p(sprintf(
    "COSMIC reference signatures v%s fitted with SigProfilerAssignment (cosmic_fit) to the PASS somatic SNVs, doublets and indels.%s",
    if (is.na(sig$cosmic_version)) "(version not recorded)" else sig$cosmic_version,
    if (!is.na(sig$lookup_version) && !identical(sig$lookup_version, sig$cosmic_version))
      sprintf(" Aetiologies are taken from the bundled COSMIC v%s lookup.", sig$lookup_version) else "")),
  tags$p(sprintf(paste0(
    "A context is flagged \"few mutations\" below %s SBS, %s DBS or %s ID mutations, and \"poor fit\" ",
    "when the cosine similarity is below %.2f. Signatures contributing at least %s%% in an unflagged ",
    "context are carried to the overview. Proposed aetiologies are COSMIC's, abbreviated; \"Unknown\" ",
    "means COSMIC proposes none (or none was certain enough to state here)."),
    sig_fmt_int(SIG_MIN_MUTATIONS[["SBS"]]), sig_fmt_int(SIG_MIN_MUTATIONS[["DBS"]]),
    sig_fmt_int(SIG_MIN_MUTATIONS[["ID"]]), SIG_MIN_COSINE, SIG_DOMINANT_MIN_PCT)),
  tags$p(paste0(
    "ID83 signatures are always fitted against COSMIC's GRCh37 reference set, whatever genome the ",
    "sample was aligned to (only SBS and DBS signatures are build-specific). Long-read indel calls in ",
    "homopolymers can inflate replication-slippage and mismatch-repair indel signatures.")),
  if (length(no_stats) > 0)
    tags$p(sprintf("No solution statistics file for %s: cosine similarity is unavailable and the mutation total is the matrix sum.",
                   paste(no_stats, collapse = ", "))),
  tags$p("Files:", lapply(sig_paths, function(p) tags$code(class = "sig-path", p)))
)
```
